Facts are deliberately distributed. No single document contains the whole answer set; most fields are corroborated by three to eleven separate documents in different folders and formats.

Questions that are not reached (portal A7 ex parte, B1 exemption type, Part I cross-vested, Applicant 2, Respondent 2, Child 4) are marked as such and MUST come back blank.

4. Q48 (s 60J advice) is 'Yes' and has no portal equivalent.
5. Child support is NOT a selected order type — it is dealt with by administrative assessment.
6. Part H applies in full because this is a de facto matter; Part C marriage/divorce fields do not.
7. Child 3 uses the paper form's second children's block (Q38-46), and Child 4 must be blank.

That the net non-superannuation property of the parties be divided as to 58 per cent to the applicant and 42 per cent to the respondent.
